title: Hourly weather of 2025, Wien Hohe Warte
description: The 8760 hours of 2025 at the weather station Wien Hohe Warte (Wien) of GeoSphere Austria, read from its dataset API as CSV. The times of the API have no seconds, so they are no xsd:dateTime: the time of a row is its position on a time grid of an hour. The weather has seasons: see the patterns tab.
